accounts.owner_or_project: Relay Protocol (relay.link) - RelayAllocator contract on Aurora
accounts.what_it_does: NEAR-side Aurora XCC account of the EVM contract RelayAllocator (0x7EdA04920F22ba6A2b9f2573fd9a6F6F1946Ff9f), which calls v1.signer.sign to MPC-sign withdrawal payloads for Relay's cross-chain depository system.
accounts.target_chain_evidence: Not Aurora/NEAR itself: signatures authorize withdrawals on Relay depositories on other chains. Docs: EVM payload builder (all EVM chains, EIP-712, Ecdsa, domain 0), Solana/Eclipse (Eddsa, domain 1), Bitcoin (Ecdsa). Verified source also has Sui (Eddsa) and Hyperliquid (Ecdsa) payload builders. Source maps Ecdsa->domain_id "0", any other curve->"1", which matches the observed mixed domain 0/1 payloads. Exact per-request target chain is not decoded from our data (inference: ECDSA = EVM/Bitcoin/Hyperliquid, EdDSA = Solana/Sui).
